KNR_HERITAGE.desc: Four centuries of the Malabar coast in one day: a Portuguese sea fort, the palace of Kerala's only Muslim royal family, the British fort at Thalassery and a drive along Kerala's famous drive-in beach.
KNR_HERITAGE.itin:
8:30 AM — Pickup: Kannur railway station · Kannur KSRTC bus station · Kannur Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
9:00 AM — St Angelo Fort: The 1505 Portuguese laterite fort on the sea, with views over Mappila Bay harbour. (Entry own expense)
10:30 AM — Arakkal Museum: The Arakkal Kettu, palace of the Ali Rajas, with their furniture, weapons and royal papers. (Closed Mondays)
12:30 PM — Thalassery Fort & lunch: The 1708 East India Company fort, then Thalassery biryani in town, own expense.
3:30 PM — Muzhappilangad drive-in beach: A slow drive along 4 km of firm sand, with Dharmadam island just offshore. (No swimming)
5:15 PM — Payyambalam Beach: Kannur's town beach and gardens for the sunset walk.
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Kannur station, KSRTC bus station, Kannur Airport, or your own stop in town
KNR_HERITAGE.gtk:
🗓️ Closing days: Arakkal Museum is closed on Mondays; on Mondays we visit the Arakkal mosque area and Kannur handloom shops instead. The forts are open daily; timings can change, so we re-confirm the evening before.
🚗 Driving on the beach: Our driver goes slowly along the hard sand, away from the waterline and people. Beach staff or police may stop vehicles at high tide or in rough weather.
🌊 Sea safety: No swimming at Muzhappilangad or Payyambalam — the currents are strong. From June to September the sea is rough; we keep to the promenade.
✈️ Flying in?: We can pick you up at Kannur Airport in the morning — it adds about an hour. Or end your day at the airport for a late flight: ask us.
KNR_HERITAGE.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KNR_HERITAGE.exc: Lunch; Fort and museum entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KNR_HERITAGE.carry: Comfortable walking shoes; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

KNR_THEYYAM.desc: See a god walk at dawn: a living Theyyam in a village kavu by firelight, then Muthappan's riverside shrine at Parassinikadavu, the snake park and the wide laterite plateau of Madayipara.
KNR_THEYYAM.itin:
4:30 AM — Pickup: Kannur railway station · Kannur KSRTC bus station · Kannur Airport (on request) (Season Dec – Apr)
5:15 AM — Dawn Theyyam at a village kavu: Chenda drums, fire and towering headdresses at a sacred grove — the kavu changes with each day's festival calendar. (Respectful conduct)
8:30 AM — Parassinikadavu Muthappan: The riverside shrine open to all, where Muthappan appears daily. Tea and boiled gram prasadam; breakfast own expense. (Modest dress)
10:00 AM — Parassinikadavu Snake Park: Cobras, vipers and pythons, with a snake-handling talk. (Entry own expense)
11:30 AM — Madayipara: A laterite table-land of grass, rock pools and old temple sites, with views to the sea. Lunch on the way back, own expense.
2:30 PM — Drop-off: Kannur station, KSRTC bus station, Kannur Airport, or your own stop in town
KNR_THEYYAM.gtk:
🔥 Theyyam season: Theyyams follow the temple festival calendar; we run this trail from December to April. Which kavu, and the exact time, changes daily — we confirm the evening before.
🙏 At the kavu: Dress modestly, remove footwear where asked and follow the volunteers. Keep clear of the dancer's path; no flash, and ask before close-up photos.
⏰ Early start: Pickup is before dawn: carry a light shawl and eat a snack before you leave. Kavus are outdoors, often on uneven ground with no seating.
✈️ Flying in?: Land the evening before — dawn pickups don't suit morning flights. We can drop you at Kannur Airport after the tour: ask us.
KNR_THEYYAM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KNR_THEYYAM.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Snake park entry, temple offerings; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KNR_THEYYAM.carry: Light shawl for the dawn chill; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Slip-on footwear; Torch or phone light

KNR_PAITHALMALA.desc: Kannur's highest hills on the Coorg border: a forest trek up Paithalmala to grassy tops, a watchtower and views to the sea, then the clouds and ridges of Palakkayam Thattu.
KNR_PAITHALMALA.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kannur railway station · Kannur KSRTC bus station · Kannur Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
9:15 AM — Paithalmala trek: About 2 km of forest path each way to the open grassland, watchtower and viewpoints at around 4,500 ft. (Moderate · 3 hrs)
1:00 PM — Lunch · Kudiyanmala: Simple Kerala meals in the hill town, own expense.
2:30 PM — Palakkayam Thattu: A hilltop meadow at about 3,500 ft with wide views of the Western Ghats; adventure activities paid direct. (Steep last stretch)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Kannur station, KSRTC bus station, Kannur Airport, or your own stop in town
KNR_PAITHALMALA.gtk:
🥾 The trek: A steady climb on a forest path, then open grassland — about 3 hours with stops. Fine for most fit adults; not for anyone with knee, heart or breathing problems.
🌧️ Weather & closures: Forest staff close the hill in heavy rain and thunderstorms; we check the evening before and offer a new date. Mist can hide the views — it is part of the charm.
🌳 Forest rules: Entry is by ticket at the gate within set hours; stay on the marked path. No plastic, no alcohol, no loud music; carry your rubbish back.
✈️ Flying in?: We can end your day at Kannur Airport for a late flight — it adds about an hour. Or pick you up there in the morning: ask us.
KNR_PAITHALMALA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KNR_PAITHALMALA.exc: Lunch; Forest entry and any jeep or activity fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KNR_PAITHALMALA.carry: Trekking shoes with grip; Raincoat or windcheater; Spare socks & salt (leeches); Cash for tickets

KNR_EZHIMALA.desc: North Malabar's quiet corner: the lone sea hill of Ezhimala with its giant Hanuman and coastal views, Kavvayi's island villages, and an afternoon boat through the Valiyaparamba backwaters.
KNR_EZHIMALA.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Kannur railway station · Kannur KSRTC bus station · Kannur Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
8:45 AM — Ezhimala hilltop: The road up the lone coastal hill to the tall Hanuman statue, with views over the sea, rivers and Payyanur. (Naval area rules)
10:45 AM — Kavvayi island: Quiet lanes, mangroves and fishing boats on an island village of the backwaters near Payyanur.
12:30 PM — Lunch · Payyanur: Malabar meals and fresh fish in town, own expense.
2:00 PM — Valiyaparamba boat ride: Two hours on the backwaters from Kottappuram, past islands, coconut groves and fishing nets. (Boat paid direct)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Kannur station, KSRTC bus station, Kannur Airport, or your own stop in town
KNR_EZHIMALA.gtk:
⚓ Naval area: Ezhimala is home to the Indian Naval Academy: visitors keep to the public road and hilltop. No photos of naval gates or buildings, and no drones.
🛶 The boat: We book a licensed operator; you pay the boat fare direct — shared or private boats. Life jackets for everyone; boats don't run in bad weather.
🌤️ Sun & walking: The hilltop and island are open and hot by late morning. Short walks only, on rough paths in places.
✈️ Flying in?: We can pick you up at Kannur Airport in the morning — it adds about an hour. Or end your day at the airport for a late flight: ask us.
KNR_EZHIMALA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KNR_EZHIMALA.exc: Lunch; Boat fare; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KNR_EZHIMALA.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Comfortable shoes; Light rain jacket; Cash for the boat

KNR_CNN.desc: Flying from Kannur International at Mattannur? We pick you up at your door anywhere in Kannur and drop you at the terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
KNR_CNN.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Kannur town, Thalassery side, Chakkarakkal or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~30 km via Chalode: About 45 minutes to 1 hour via Chovva, Chalode and Mattannur — longer at peak hours.
Drop-off — Kannur International Airport: Departures kerb at Mattannur. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KNR_CNN.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 4 hours before an international flight and 3 hours before a domestic one. Thana, Chovva and Mattannur town can jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 At the airport: Kannur airport has one terminal building for domestic and international flights. Tell us your flight and we drop you at the right departures door.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Kannur?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KNR_CNN.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KNR_CNN.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
KNR_CNN.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Web check-in done; Water for the drive

KNR_CCJ.desc: Flying from Calicut International at Karipur? We pick you up at your door anywhere in Kannur and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
KNR_CCJ.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Kannur town, Thalassery, Mahe side or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~120 km on NH 66: About 3 hours via the Thalassery–Mahe bypass, Vadakara, Koyilandy and the Kozhikode bypass to Ramanattukara.
Drop-off — Calicut International Airport: Domestic or international departures at Karipur. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KNR_CCJ.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 6 hours before an international flight and 5 hours before a domestic one. Vadakara, Koyilandy and Ramanattukara can jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Karipur has separate domestic and international terminals on one campus. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Karipur?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KNR_CCJ.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KNR_CCJ.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
KNR_CCJ.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal noted; Water for the drive

KNR_COORG.desc: Up the Makutta ghat into Karnataka's coffee country: misty Madikeri, Abbey Falls, a Raja's Seat sunset, Dubare's elephants and the Tibetan Golden Temple — your own vehicle and driver.
KNR_COORG.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Coorg: From your door in Kannur — about 120 km via Mattannur, Iritty and the Makutta ghat, roughly 4 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · late morning — Abbey Falls: A short walk down through coffee and spice estates to the falls near Madikeri. Lunch in town. (Entry own expense · no bathing)
Day 1 · evening — Madikeri Fort & Raja's Seat: The old fort in town, then the kings' sunset lookout over misty hills. Overnight in Madikeri. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 8:30 AM — Dubare Elephant Camp: Watch the camp elephants bathe and feed by the Kaveri — reached by boat. (Mornings only · paid direct)
Day 2 · noon — Golden Temple, Bylakuppe: The great Namdroling monastery in the Tibetan settlement; Tibetan lunch nearby. (Shoes off · quiet inside)
Day 2 · ~7:00 PM — Drive home: About 145 km via Siddapur, Virajpet and Makutta; at your door in Kannur by evening.
KNR_COORG.gtk:
🐘 Dubare & the seasons: Elephant activities run only in the morning; the boat crossing can stop when the river is high. Falls and hill paths are slippery in the monsoon (June–September).
🛕 Temples & monastery: Omkareshwara: modest dress, footwear off, temple customs apply. Golden Temple: shoes off and quiet inside; follow the signs on photos.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Coorg is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules and the ghat road before you travel.
🏨 Your stay: You book one night in or near Madikeri — coffee-estate homestays are a Coorg favourite. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
KNR_COORG.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Coorg sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KNR_COORG.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, elephant camp and boat fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KNR_COORG.carry: Light jacket and raincoat; Photo ID; Comfortable walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

KNR_WAYANAD.desc: Up the Periya ghat to Kerala's green north: Kabini river islands, India's largest earth dam, a forest lake and Edakkal's ancient carvings — two easy days with your own vehicle and driver.
KNR_WAYANAD.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door in Kannur — about 75 km via Kuthuparamba, Nedumpoil and the Periya ghat to Mananthavady, roughly 2.5 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 10:00 AM — Kuruva Island: Forest-covered river islands on the Kabini, crossed on foot or by bamboo raft. (Seasonal · daily cap · paid direct)
Day 1 · afternoon — Banasura Sagar Dam: India's largest earth dam, with green islands in the reservoir. Overnight in Kalpetta or Vythiri. (Entry & boating own expense)
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Pookode Lake & Lakkidi: A forest lake, then the viewpoint over the Thamarassery ghat. (Boating optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · late morning — Edakkal Caves: A short, steep climb to caves with prehistoric rock carvings. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 2 · ~6:00 PM — Drive home: Leave Wayanad by 2:30 PM so the Periya ghat is done in daylight; home in Kannur by evening.
KNR_WAYANAD.gtk:
🪨 Edakkal Caves: Closed on Mondays — on a Sunday start we swap the days around. The climb is steep: not ideal for elders or small children.
🌧️ Seasonal spots: Kuruva Island closes in the monsoon and has a daily visitor cap; rafts stop when the river runs high. We check on the day and swap stops.
🏨 Your stay: You book your resort or homestay; Kalpetta and Vythiri are central. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
⛰️ The ghat: The Periya ghat can close after landslips in heavy rain. We check the road the day before and come down before dark.
KNR_WAYANAD.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Wayanad sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KNR_WAYANAD.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and raft fees; Tolls and parking
KNR_WAYANAD.carry: Walking shoes; Raincoat; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

KNR_MOOKAMBIKA.desc: Up the coast to Udupi's Krishna temple, then inland to the Mookambika Devi temple at Kollur under the Kodachadri hills — with a Maravanthe sea-and-river stop on the way home.
KNR_MOOKAMBIKA.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive north: From your door in Kannur — about 200 km on NH 66 via Kasaragod and Mangaluru to Udupi, roughly 5 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · late morning — Udupi Sri Krishna Matha: Darshan through the Kanakana Kindi window, the old Car Street mathas and a classic Udupi veg lunch. (Men shirts off · no jeans)
Day 1 · evening — Kollur Mookambika: About 75 km inland under the Kodachadri hills: evening darshan at the Devi temple; overnight in Kollur. (Decent traditional dress)
Day 2 · early — Morning darshan & Souparnika: An early visit before the crowds, and the Souparnika river beside the temple. (Optional · queues on festivals)
Day 2 · 9:30 AM — Maravanthe beach: Where NH 66 runs on a strip of sand between the Arabian Sea and the Souparnika river. (Photos only · no swimming)
Day 2 · ~5:30 PM — Drive home: About 245 km south via Udupi and Mangaluru, lunch on the way; at your door in Kannur by evening.
KNR_MOOKAMBIKA.gtk:
🛕 Temple dress: Udupi: men remove shirts inside; no jeans, T-shirts, shorts or sleeveless wear. Kollur: decent traditional dress; footwear off at both temples.
🪔 Crowds & timings: Kollur is busiest on Fridays, weekends and during Navaratri — expect long queues. Both temples close for a while around midday; we plan darshan around it.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Udupi and Kollur are in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🏨 Your stay: You book one night in Kollur — temple-run and private lodges near the temple. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
KNR_MOOKAMBIKA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Udupi, Kollur and Maravanthe drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KNR_MOOKAMBIKA.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Temple sevas and offerings; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KNR_MOOKAMBIKA.carry: Traditional clothes for temples; Photo ID; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for offerings

KNR_MYSORE.desc: Through Coorg's coffee hills and the Tibetan Golden Temple to Mysore's palace, Chamundi Hill, Srirangapatna and Brindavan — a royal road trip in your own vehicle.
KNR_MYSORE.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive via Coorg: From your door in Kannur — via Iritty, the Makutta ghat, Virajpet and Kushalnagar; about 235 km to Mysore. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · late morning — Golden Temple, Bylakuppe: The Namdroling monastery in the Tibetan settlement; Tibetan lunch, then Mysore by mid-afternoon. (Shoes off · quiet inside)
Day 1 · evening — Devaraja Market & St Philomena's: Mysore's flower and spice market and the tall Gothic cathedral. (Easy evening walk)
Day 2 · morning — Chamundi Hill & Mysore Palace: The hilltop temple and city view, then the Wodeyars' palace of stained glass and mirrors. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Srirangapatna & Brindavan Gardens: Tipu Sultan's island fort, then the gardens and musical fountain below KRS dam. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 · 7:00 AM — Drive home: About 235 km back through Coorg and the Makutta ghat; at your door in Kannur by mid-afternoon.
KNR_MYSORE.gtk:
🏰 Mysore Palace: The palace lights up on Sunday and holiday evenings — a Saturday start catches it. Shoes are removed inside — carry socks.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Mysore is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules and the ghat road before you travel.
🌳 Makutta forest: The Makutta ghat runs through forest with elephants — we cross it in daylight both ways. No stopping or feeding animals inside the forest.
🏨 Your stays: You book two nights in Mysore; near the palace is easiest. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
KNR_MYSORE.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Mysore sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
KNR_MYSORE.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Palace, garden and entry fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KNR_MYSORE.carry: Photo ID; Socks for the palace; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

KNR_BEKAL.desc: Your own vehicle for a full day in Kasaragod: a morning trek up Ranipuram's grassy shola hills, then Bekal's great sea fort and a beach sunset — Ranipuram is about 3 hours from Kannur.
KNR_BEKAL.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: From your door, hotel, Kannur station or the KSRTC stand; north on NH 66, breakfast at Kanhangad.
9:30 AM — Ranipuram trek: A 2.5 km forest path with rails and shelters to grassy hilltops at about 750 m — 2 to 3 hours up and down. (Forest dept. ticket · paid direct)
1:00 PM — Lunch on the way down: Kerala meals at Panathur or Kanhangad, own expense.
3:00 PM — Bekal Fort: Kerala's largest fort: a giant keyhole of laterite walls and bastions over the sea. (Entry own expense)
5:00 PM — Bekal beach park: Sunset on the beach beside the fort. (No swimming in rough sea)
8:00 PM — Drop-off: Back to your door or any stop in Kannur.
KNR_BEKAL.gtk:
⛰️ Ranipuram trek: Last entry to the trail is about 3 PM and all walkers must be down by 5 PM — so we go in the morning. Leeches in the monsoon; elephants live in this forest — stay on the trail.
🏰 Bekal Fort: Open every day, roughly 8 AM to 6 PM; entry own expense. High walls with open edges in places — keep children close.
🌊 Beach safety: Swim only at lifeguard-flagged spots; no sea bathing in the monsoon (June–September). Bekal beach park has its own small entry fee.
👟 Fitness: The trek is easy but steady uphill; elders can wait at the base, which has restrooms and snacks. Wear shoes with grip — the path is slippery after rain.
KNR_BEKAL.inc: Private vehicle and driver; No waiting charges; Driver bata; Pickup anywhere in Kannur
KNR_BEKAL.exc: Meals; Trek, fort and beach park fees; Tolls and parking
KNR_BEKAL.carry: Walking shoes with grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Water bottle; Cash for entry fees

KNR_VELANKANNI.desc: From Kannur to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health at Velankanni — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, the Way of the Cross and Morning Star Church, at an easy pace.
KNR_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup: Kannur railway station · Kannur KSRTC bus station · Kannur Airport (on request)
Day 1 · 4:35 PM — Down the coast to Karur: NH 66 past Kozhikode, then via Palakkad and Coimbatore. (Room booked by you)
Day 2 · 11:00 AM — Velankanni Basilica: Check in, then the shrine of Our Lady of Good Health and Our Lady's Tank. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · evening — Rosary & the beach: Evening rosary and candle prayers at the shrine; a walk on the beach. (No sea bathing)
Day 3 · morning — Mass & the Way of the Cross: Morning Mass, Our Lady's path, Morning Star Church and the museum. (Malayalam Mass — re-confirm)
Day 3 · 1:30 PM — Drive to Karur: Back via Thanjavur and Trichy; night in Karur. (Room booked by you)
Day 4 · 4:30 PM — Drop-off: Kannur station, KSRTC bus station, Kannur Airport, or your own stop in town
KNR_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the Basilica: Dress modestly — shoulders and knees covered; footwear off where asked. Masses run all day in several languages, usually one in Malayalam — we re-confirm the time.
🌊 Beach & crowds: The sea at Velankanni is rough and drownings have been reported — no swimming. Keep children close; we fix a meeting point at the Basilica arch.
🕯️ At an easy pace: A full, unhurried day at the shrine — Mass, the Way of the Cross and evening rosary. Buy candles and offerings only at the shrine's own counters.
🛣️ Long drive & rooms: Breaks every 2–3 hours; no driving after 9 PM. You book your rooms in Karur and Velankanni; we share a list of pilgrim lodges near the shrine.
KNR_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KNR_VELANKANNI.exc: Your rooms; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KNR_VELANKANNI.carry: Modest clothes for church; Photo ID; Your regular medicines; Cash for offerings and candles
